description.value: All-you-can-eat sushi restaurant located in the Nordel Crossing Centre, offering both regular menu and AYCE options. Provides pickup ordering for convenient takeout. A casual dining option for cyclists seeking Japanese cuisine.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Nordel Sushi is an operational all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant with takeout ordering available via 'ORDER PICKUP'. Phone number and website URL match OSM values. Address discrepancy: OSM lists Richmond but website clearly shows Surrey, and OSM address lacks unit and city designation. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but website and address indicate Surrey
OSM address missing unit number (#125) and city (Surrey) designation shown on website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant with confirmed takeout. Legitimate dining option for touring cyclists.
